hints.title: Single and Double Character Transitions
hints.text: Each step depends solely on decoding the current character individually or pairing it with the immediately preceding character.

hints.title: Wildcard Multipliers
hints.text: An asterisk can be any digit from 1 to 9 alone. When paired, consider cases where the first character is 1, 2, or asterisk, multiplying by the valid outcomes.

hints.title: Constant Space State Progression
hints.text: Maintain two running counts representing decodings ending at index minus one and index minus two. For the current index, evaluate single-digit possibilities and two-digit combinations, applying modulo arithmetic at each transition.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: Fibonacci-style recurrence tracking combinations formed by 1 and 2 character suffixes.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Recursively exploring each wildcard branch takes exponential O(9^N) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Retaining only the two preceding counts keeps space consumption at O(1).
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Carefully enumerate combinations where single characters or pairs include asterisks.
